items.title: More money goes to protein crops
items.text: France raises the share of CAP payments tied to protein crops from 2.3% in 2023 to 3.5% in 2027.

items.title: 2026 rates not confirmed yet
items.text: The legume payment we show (about €104 per hectare) comes from the 2022 plan. Check TelePAC for the 2026 rate.
